series.name: Clear Air
series.line: A series for letting go of smoking

sessions.title: For Someone You Love and Miss
sessions.line: For when you miss someone and want to feel close to them.

sessions.title: The Quantum Reset
sessions.line: For evenings when you want to put the day's self down and start fresh.

sessions.title: Open to Receive
sessions.line: For when some part of you is still braced against having more.

sessions.title: When Your Mind Won't Stop at Bedtime
sessions.line: Close the day's open tabs and let the list wait for morning.

sessions.title: Two Minutes Between Things
sessions.line: One slow reset between meetings or errands.

sessions.title: When You Wake Up Already Tense
sessions.line: For mornings when the tightness gets there before the day does.

sessions.title: Still Enough to Sleep
sessions.line: Let the day be done, and sink into sleep.

sessions.title: Connecting to Abundance and Prosperity
sessions.line: Feel connected to everything, and open your hands to what is coming.

sessions.title: The Frequency of Enough
sessions.line: When the day was all measuring, feel that you have done enough.

sessions.title: Before You Check Anything
sessions.line: The first minutes of the day, before anything else gets in.

sessions.title: Before You Say Yes
sessions.line: Someone asks. One breath before you answer.

sessions.title: Before the Week Starts
sessions.line: Sunday evening, when the week lands in your chest: name each thing, set the weight down.

sessions.title: The Empowerment Practice
sessions.line: Remember that you are powerful: feet, breath, heat in the chest, and the fire that is already yours.

sessions.title: The Abundance Practice
sessions.line: Feel abundance as something already here: warmth in the chest, one thing you have, the sense of enough.

sessions.title: After a Tense Conversation
sessions.line: Let a tense conversation settle: jaw, shoulders, hands, feet on the ground.

sessions.title: The Pause Before Asking
sessions.line: Name a price for your work, rehearse a real offer, and let the sentence end.

sessions.title: Stress Without the Cigarette
sessions.line: Choose one small thing to try before reaching for a cigarette.

sessions.title: A New Small Ritual
sessions.line: Choose one small action for a familiar pause in your day.

sessions.title: When the Urge Arrives
sessions.line: Notice what is here, then choose one helpful next step.

sessions.title: Remembering Your Reason
sessions.line: Reconnect with your own reason for wanting to stop smoking.

sessions.title: This Precious Life
sessions.line: An ordinary moment, and life here in this breath.

sessions.title: Let Them Think What They Think
sessions.line: Room to be yourself without carrying every opinion.

sessions.title: A Soft Place to Land
sessions.line: Nothing to do for a while.

sessions.title: Still Enough to Listen
sessions.line: Nine quiet minutes to be still and notice your breath.
